Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. The reports of the independent registered public accounting firm, consolidated financial statements, and notes to consolidated financial statements are presented in Item 15 of this Form 10-K. Item 9. Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure. None. Item 9A. Controls and Procedures. Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures Disclosure controls and procedures are designed to provide reasonable assurance that information required to be disclosed in Eaton's reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the Securities and Exchange Commission's rules and forms. Disclosure controls and procedures include, without limitation, controls and procedures designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed in Eaton's reports filed under the Exchange Act is accumulated and communicated to management, including Eaton's Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure. Pursuant to Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) of the Exchange Act, an evaluation was performed under the supervision and with the participation of Eaton's management, including the Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer, of the effectiveness of the design and operation of the Company's disclosure controls and procedures. Based on that evaluation, the Principal Executive Officer and Principal Financial Officer concluded that Eaton's disclosure controls and procedures were effective at a reasonable assurance level as of December 31, 2025. Internal Control over Financial Reporting Pursuant to Section 404 of the Sarbanes Oxley Act of 2002 and the rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto, Eaton has included a report of management's assessment of the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting, which is included in Item 15 of this Form 10-K. “Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm” relating to internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025 is included in Item 15 of this Form 10-K. During the fourth quarter of 2025, there was no change in Eaton's internal control over financial reporting that materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, internal control over financial reporting. Management is currently evaluating the impact of businesses acquired in the past twelve months on Eaton's internal control over financial reporting. Item 9B. Other Information. Eaton Corporation plc (Eaton or the Company) is an intelligent power management company dedicated to protecting the environment and improving the quality of life for people everywhere. We make products for the data center, utility, industrial, commercial, machine building, residential, aerospace and mobility markets. We are capitalizing on the megatrends of the electrification, digitalization, and the reindustrialization of and growth of megaprojects in North America and increased global infrastructure spending, all of which are expanding our end markets and positioning Eaton for growth for years to come. We are strengthening our participation across the entire electrical power value chain and benefiting from momentum in the data center and utility end markets as well as a growth cycle in the commercial aerospace and defense markets. We are guided by our commitment to operate sustainably and with the highest ethical standards. Our work is helping to solve the world’s most urgent power management challenges and building a more sustainable society for people today and for future generations. Founded in 1911, Eaton has continuously evolved to meet the changing and expanding needs of our stakeholders. With revenues of $27.4 billion in 2025, the Company serves customers in 180 countries. Eaton electronically files or furnishes reports pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act) to the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), including annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and proxy and information statements, as well as any amendments to those reports. As soon as reasonably practicable, these reports are available free of charge through the Company's website at www.eaton.com. These filings are also accessible on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov. credit_strengths.text: Eaton's operating cash flow comfortably funds capital expenditure, leaving substantial free cash flow that covers dividends and buybacks while still reducing net leverage. This internally generated liquidity, supported by a broad electrical and aerospace portfolio, underpins the modest financial risk profile and provides flexibility for acquisitions without straining the balance sheet.

Interest coverage is exceptionally strong, with operating income covering gross interest expense many times over, well above the sector median. This headroom reflects modest absolute debt and a low average cost of borrowings, and it cushions the issuer against earnings volatility or a rising rate environment.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a large current portion of long-term debt maturing within the next twelve months, alongside additional maturities in the following years. Refinancing this concentration depends on continued access to unsecured markets, and any disruption could pressure liquidity or raise funding costs.

Eaton's growth strategy relies on acquisitions, and management is still evaluating the impact of recently acquired businesses on internal control over financial reporting. Integration and control risks could distract management or require unplanned capital, while shareholder distributions already absorb most free cash flow.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow to debt sits comfortably above the sector median, and net leverage remains below the sector median on a comparable basis. This supports a strong capacity to service obligations, although the ratio's sensitivity to acquisition spending or a demand downturn warrants monitoring.

The liquidity profile is adequate, with a current ratio modestly above the sector median and a cash balance that, while small relative to debt, is supplemented by robust operating cash flow. Near-term maturities are manageable given the recurring cash generation.

overall_credit_view.text: Eaton presents a modest financial risk profile, with leverage below the sector median and cash-flow coverage above it. The indicative profile is not a rating, but the combination of scale, end-market diversity and consistent cash generation supports a stable credit trajectory over the medium term.

Our forward view is that leverage will remain near current levels, as free cash flow covers shareholder returns and bolt-on acquisitions. However, a large debt maturity within the next year and integration of recent acquisitions are key watch items; a material debt-funded deal could pressure the modest profile.

credit_strengths.text: 伊頓的營運現金流足以輕鬆支應資本支出，留下大量自由現金流，既能覆蓋股息與回購，同時仍可降低淨槓桿。此內部產生的流動性，加上廣泛的電氣與航空航太產品組合支持，支撐了溫和的財務風險狀況，並為收購提供靈活性，而不會對資產負債表造成壓力。
利息覆蓋率極為強勁，營運利潤覆蓋總利息支出的倍數遠高於行業中位數。此緩衝空間反映了絕對債務規模溫和及借款平均成本較低，並使發行人能夠抵禦盈利波動或利率上升的環境。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露了未來十二個月內到期的大量長期債務流動部分，以及隨後幾年的額外到期債務。為此集中到期的債務進行再融資取決於能否持續進入無擔保市場，任何中斷都可能對流動性造成壓力或提高融資成本。
伊頓的增長策略依賴收購，管理層仍在評估近期收購的業務對財務報告內部控制的影響。整合與控制風險可能分散管理層注意力或需要計劃外資本，而股東分配已吸收大部分自由現金流。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流對債務比率舒適地高於行業中位數，且淨槓桿在可比基礎上仍低於行業中位數。這支持了強勁的償債能力，儘管該比率對收購支出或需求下滑的敏感性值得監測。
流動性狀況充足，流動比率略高於行業中位數，且現金餘額雖相對於債務規模較小，但得到強勁營運現金流的補充。鑑於經常性現金生成，近期到期債務可控。

overall_credit_view.text: 伊頓呈現溫和的財務風險狀況，槓桿低於行業中位數，現金流覆蓋率則高於行業中位數。指示性概況並非評級，但規模、終端市場多樣性及持續現金生成的結合，支持中期內穩定的信用軌跡。
我們的前瞻觀點是，槓桿將維持在當前水平附近，因自由現金流覆蓋股東回報及補強型收購。然而，未來一年內的大量債務到期及近期收購的整合是關鍵觀察事項；一項重大債務融資交易可能對溫和的財務狀況造成壓力。
